title: fix: align READ domain examples and the event parameter addition article
summary: Updated READ domain examples to match actual knowledge folders and corrected guidance on event parameter additions to align with AppSourceCop AS0024 rules.
key_points: READ's domain examples no longer name folders that do not exist (ux, api, pipelines, supply-chain, manufacturing, jobs)
READ now says a file's domain is the name of its knowledge/<domain>/ folder; the no-closed-enumeration rule is unchanged
The event parameter article now says subscribers never break at any position; the only exception is callers of a public publisher
The article points to its sibling add-new-event-parameters-at-the-end, adds the as0024 keyword and cites AppSourceCop AS0024
No structure, schema or skill behavior changes
quote: No knowledge folder uses them; the corresponding domains are `ui`, `web-services` and `scm`.
